reason: Both plans hit exactly 12 steps and satisfy every hard requirement (backup-before-modification ordering, rehearsal, integrity checks, stakeholder communication, rollback) with essentially the same technical approach and the same minor issues (e.g., installing replication tooling before the baseline backup, and using pg_checksums for cross-server comparison).
